instruction: Apply strikethrough formatting to all text content on this slide (including the table).

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires applying strikethrough formatting to all text including table content. Evaluator checks all text runs to verify strikethrough attribute is set.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: Incorrect API usage for checking strikethrough formatting - uses `run.font._element.attrib.get('strike', 'noStrike')` which accesses private XML attributes incorrectly
The comparison `if strike_attr == 'noStrike'` expects a string value, but python-pptx's strikethrough property returns boolean/None, not strings like 'noStrike'
Should use public API `run.font.strike` which returns True/False/None instead of accessing internal XML attributes
Logic will likely fail at runtime or return incorrect results because XML attrib dictionary may not contain 'strike' key at all
Positive: Good coverage - checks both regular text shapes and table cells as required by instruction
Positive: Appropriate postconfig with file save operation
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Replace `strike_attr = run.font._element.attrib.get('strike', 'noStrike')` with proper python-pptx API call
Use `if run.font.strike is None or run.font.strike == False:` to check if strikethrough is not applied
Apply the same fix to both regular text shapes (line 29-30) and table cells (line 42-43)
Consider adding better error handling to distinguish between file read failures and verification failures
